title: SVG Scribble Draw-On Image Hover
description: A 3x2 grid of square image cards, each overlaid with two oversized scribbled SVG paths. On mouseenter the strokes draw themselves on (strokeDashoffset animated from full path length to 0 via getTotalLength) while their stroke-width swells from 200 to 700, and the card title rises word by word with a SplitText mask; on mouseleave everything reverses.

motion.motion_signature: Hover-triggered dual-layer SVG draw-on: two oversized scribble paths per card are dash-offset to their full getTotalLength() at init and tweened to 0 over 1.5s with power2.out (a fast initial sweep that decays into a slow tail, reading like a pencil stroke running out of speed), while the masked SplitText title rises yPercent 100->0 in 0.75s power3.out, 0.075s per word, entering 0.35s into the draw. Exit is deliberately asymmetric and faster — 1s un-draw, 0.5s word retreat staggered 0.05s from the end — and each crossing kills and rebuilds the timeline, so a rapid in/out re-fires from wherever the strokes happen to be. No scroll coupling of any kind; Lenis is present only as ambient page smoothing.
